name: brain-rot-tracker
description: Rescue your attention span - track and reduce digital brain rot

scripts.setup: npm run setup:rust && npm run setup:node && npm run setup:db
scripts.setup:node: npm install && cd dashboard && npm install && cd ../app && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:daemon" "npm run dev:dashboard" "npm run dev:app"
scripts.dev:app: cd app && npm run tauri dev
scripts.build: npm run build:daemon && npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:app
scripts.build:app: cd app && npm run tauri build
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:js
scripts.test:js: cd dashboard && npm test && cd ../app && npm test
scripts.lint: npm run lint:rust && npm run lint:js
scripts.lint:js: cd dashboard && npm run lint && cd ../app && npm run lint
scripts.clean: cd daemon && cargo clean && cd ../dashboard && rm -rf dist node_modules && cd ../app && rm -rf dist node_modules

author: Tony Condone
